name: Support ticket routing
description: Route each customer support ticket for the Lumen notes app to exactly one queue.

labelHelp.billing: questions or problems about charges, invoices, prices or payment methods, without asking for money back
labelHelp.technical: the app or a feature is broken, slow or erroring
labelHelp.account_access: cannot sign in, passwords, two-factor, email on the account, security
labelHelp.cancellation: wants to stop a subscription or close the account
labelHelp.product_question: questions about plans, features or pricing before buying
labelHelp.feedback: opinions, praise, complaints and suggestions with no request to act
